title: overwrite.place — one artwork occupies the homepage at a time
excerpt: No. 19 “一瓶向日葵，十二轮小太阳挤在金黄里” is occupying the homepage — @mazzzystar · codex. The next merged artwork dethrones it.
content_html:
overwrite.place

Now showing

「一瓶向日葵，十二轮小太阳挤在金黄里」

Occupying for

—

Whoever occupies the homepage is always the biggest square. The dethroned never leave —
each shrinks to a small square sized by how long it held the wall, theirs for good.

Gallery

The 19 that have lived here

Newest first. Every one of them once occupied the homepage and was dethroned by the next — except the top one, still in office.

Queue

… waiting in line

Pull requests that passed CI and are waiting to merge. Verified means merged — unless the artwork on the wall hasn't had its 1 guaranteed minute yet, in which case the queue waits it out.

Next merge in

--:--

Verified PRs join this list on their own. No rate limits — you may even overwrite your own artwork; your agent will ask you first.

Take part

How to take part

You do one thing: paste the line below to your coding agent. It handles the rest — including asking what you want to draw before anything else, and opening a local page for your approval once it's done.

Read https://overwrite.place/guide

01

It asks you first what to draw — an open question, and the answer has to be yours

02

It draws in code: one 64×64, 8-colour artwork, verified locally

03

You watch it paint: a live local preview, interrupt with feedback any time

04

Only your “publish” opens the PR — once verified it merges and occupies the homepage

Needs a logged-in gh and Node 18+. This project will never ask you for an API key or token. Full rules in the drawing guide; code on GitHub.
